zh: 请求必须按顺序访问，每一段的起点和终点都是确定的，所以总时间就是各段最短时间之和，段与段之间没有取舍。
环上两站之间只有顺时针、逆时针两条不绕圈的路径，长度之和是周长；用边长前缀和得到顺向距离 d，另一方向是周长减 d，取较小者。
求前缀和 prefix 与周长 total，当前站 at=0；依次读入请求站 s（转成 0 起点），d=|prefix[s]-prefix[at]|，答案加上 min(d,total-d)，再令 at=s。答案用 64 位整数。
en: Requests must be visited in order, so every leg has a fixed start and end; the total time is the sum of the shortest time of each leg, and legs do not interact.

Between two stations on a ring there are only two non-looping paths, clockwise and counterclockwise, whose lengths add up to the perimeter; prefix sums of the edge lengths give the forward distance d, the other direction is the perimeter minus d, and you take the smaller.

Build prefix and the perimeter total, start with at = 0; for each requested station s (converted to 0-based) compute d = |prefix[s] - prefix[at]|, add min(d, total - d) to the answer, and set at = s. Use a 64-bit answer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Prefix sums give the distance d along the forward unrolling; choose min(d, (total perimeter) - d) for each leg and update the current station.

## Correctness

Between consecutive requests the drone must go from a fixed start to a fixed end, and on a ring with positive edge weights the shortest path is one of the two simple arcs. Every leg's endpoint is fixed, so there is no trade-off across legs; choosing the shortest for each and adding them up is globally optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(m+q), space O(m+q).
